title: Negative dollar values render in accounting parentheses on screen, in money columns only
custom_preconds: 1. A row with a negative money value exists (e.g., a net credit/return invoice, or a negative Labor Margin from cost exceeding billed labor — seed ZZAUTOTEST data).
custom_steps:
1. Read the negative money cell.
2. Read a negative Inv. Hrs cell and a negative Margin % cell for comparison.
custom_expected:
1. Negative dollar values render in accounting-convention parentheses — ($1,234.56) — on screen, across every money column (Labor Invoiced, Labor Margin, Parts Invoiced, Parts Margin, Margin, Subtotal).
2. Inv. Hrs (a signed time value) and Margin % (a signed percentage) are excluded — they use a leading minus, not parentheses.
